reviewCommand.source:
"""Read retained planner transcripts; do not execute native helpers or producers."""
import hashlib, json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone

ROOT = Path('/Users/erik/.codex/worktrees/1598/umf')
SELF = Path('/private/tmp/pg-private-planner-astra-review.py')
if Path.cwd().resolve() != ROOT or Path(__file__).resolve() != SELF or len(sys.argv) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError('Unknown exact review invocation')
BASE = ROOT / 'docs/helix/04-build/evidence/security'
NATIVE = BASE / 'pg-private-diagnostics.json'
OUT = BASE / 'pg-private-planner-astra-review.json'
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
canonical = lambda x: json.dumps(x, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False)
def equal(a, b):
    assert canonical(a) == canonical(b), (a, b)

source_names = [
    'tools/security/pg-private-diagnostics.py',
    'tests/security/native/pg-raw-membership.py',
    'docs/helix/03-test/security/cases.json',
    'tests/security/native/pg-raw-membership-oracle.json',
    'tests/security/native/pg-raw-membership.sql',
]
docs = [
    'docs/helix/02-design/contracts/CONTRACT-052-security-semantics.md',
    'docs/helix/02-design/contracts/CONTRACT-053-security-enforcement.md',
    'docs/helix/02-design/spikes/SPIKE-010-security-result-coverage.md',
    'docs/helix/02-design/spikes/security/pg-planner-observation-v0.1.md',
    'docs/helix/03-test/test-plans/STP-056-security-bindings.md',
]
frozen = {str(p):p.read_bytes() for p in [SELF, NATIVE, Path(sys.executable).resolve(),
    *(ROOT/n for n in source_names + docs)]}
prior = OUT.read_bytes() if OUT.exists() else None
native = json.loads(frozen[str(NATIVE)])
assert native['status'] == 'counterexample-reproduced'
assert native['engine']['number'] == '170009'
assert native['restrictedPrototypeOnly'] is True
equal(native['sourceDigests'], {n:sha(frozen[str(ROOT/n)]) for n in source_names})
plan = json.loads(frozen[str(ROOT/source_names[2])])
selected = [c for c in plan['cases'] if c['id'] == 'pg-raw.B01']
assert len(selected) == 1
closure = [selected[0]['testSource'], selected[0]['oracleSource'], *selected[0]['implementationSources']]
equal(closure, ['tests/security/native/pg-raw-membership.py',
    'tests/security/native/pg-raw-membership-oracle.json', 'tests/security/native/pg-raw-membership.sql'])
equal(native['frozenHelperInputs'], closure)
assert native['fixtureSqlExecutedFromCapturedBytes'] is True
helper = frozen[str(ROOT/source_names[1])].decode('utf-8')
marker = 'receipt=None\ntry:\n'
assert helper.count(marker) == 1
prefix = helper.split(marker)[0]
replacements = [
    ("plan=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/helix/03-test/security/cases.json').read_text())", "plan=json.loads(_captured['docs/helix/03-test/security/cases.json'])"),
    ('sources={p:digest((ROOT/p).read_bytes()) for p in paths}', 'sources={p:digest(_captured[p]) for p in paths}'),
    ("oracle=json.loads((ROOT/case['oracleSource']).read_text())", "oracle=json.loads(_captured[case['oracleSource']])"),
]
for before, after in replacements:
    assert prefix.count(before) == 1
    prefix = prefix.replace(before, after)
assert sha(prefix.encode()) == native['executedHelperPrefixSha256']

actors = ['umf_sec_alice', 'umf_sec_bob', 'umf_sec_outsider']
expected_rows = {
    'umf_sec_alice': [['RA','A-only'], ['RAB','multiple-owners']],
    'umf_sec_bob': [['RAB','multiple-owners'], ['RB','B-only']],
    'umf_sec_outsider': [],
}
oracle = json.loads(frozen[str(ROOT/source_names[3])])
equal(list(oracle['actors']), actors)
equal({a:oracle['actors'][a]['rows'] for a in actors}, expected_rows)
all_observations = native['observations']
assert len(all_observations) == 94
stages = {
    'caller-planner-diagnostics':3, 'caller-planner-two-private-worlds':3,
    'routine-local-planner-diagnostic-guard':3, 'guarded-planner-two-private-worlds':3,
    'planner-guard-restores-caller-settings':3, 'individual-planner-guard-weakened':9,
    'planner-guard-restored-native-configuration':1, 'planner-guard-independent-wrapper-inventory':1,
}
reviewed = [o for o in all_observations if o['stage'] in stages]
assert len(reviewed) == 26
for stage, count in stages.items():
    assert len([o for o in reviewed if o['stage'] == stage]) == count
suffixes = {
    'caller-planner-diagnostics':'caller',
    'caller-planner-two-private-worlds':'changed-private-population',
    'routine-local-planner-diagnostic-guard':'guarded',
    'guarded-planner-two-private-worlds':'guarded-changed-world',
}
log_records = []
for observation in reviewed:
    if 'diagnosticLog' not in observation:
        continue
    suffix = suffixes.get(observation['stage'])
    if observation['stage'] == 'individual-planner-guard-weakened':
        assert observation['parameter'] in ['debug_print_plan','debug_print_parse','debug_print_rewritten']
        suffix = 'weakened-' + observation['parameter']
    expected_path = BASE / ('pg-private-planner-' + native['runId'] + '-' + observation['actor'] + '-' + suffix + '.log')
    assert observation['diagnosticLog'] == str(expected_path.relative_to(ROOT))
    frozen[str(expected_path)] = expected_path.read_bytes()
    raw = frozen[str(expected_path)]
    text = raw.decode('utf-8')
    assert text.encode('utf-8') == raw
    assert sha(raw) == observation['diagnosticSha256']
    log_records.append({'path':str(expected_path), 'sha256':sha(raw), 'bytes':len(raw),
        'actor':observation['actor'], 'stage':observation['stage'],
        'parameter':observation.get('parameter'),
        'relationOids':re.findall(r':relid\s+([0-9]+)',text),
        'planRowEstimates':re.findall(r'plan_rows\s+([0-9.]+)',text)})
assert len(log_records) == 21 and len({l['path'] for l in log_records}) == 21

def row(stage, actor=None, parameter=None):
    found = [o for o in reviewed if o['stage'] == stage and o.get('actor') == actor and o.get('parameter') == parameter]
    assert len(found) == 1, (stage, actor, parameter)
    return found[0]
def log(o):
    return next(l for l in log_records if l['path'] == str(ROOT/o['diagnosticLog']))
observations = []
def record(identifier, expected, observed):
    equal(expected, observed)
    observations.append({'id':identifier, 'expected':expected, 'observed':observed})
record('exact-frozen-native-source-inventory', 5, len(native['sourceDigests']))
record('exact-selected-helper-closure', closure, native['frozenHelperInputs'])
record('captured-helper-prefix-correspondence', sha(prefix.encode()), native['executedHelperPrefixSha256'])
record('retained-receipt-and-reviewed-stage-counts', {'total':94,'reviewed':26,'transcripts':21},
       {'total':len(all_observations),'reviewed':len(reviewed),'transcripts':len(log_records)})
for actor in actors:
    initial = row('caller-planner-diagnostics',actor)
    changed = row('caller-planner-two-private-worlds',actor)
    guarded = row('routine-local-planner-diagnostic-guard',actor)
    guarded_changed = row('guarded-planner-two-private-worlds',actor)
    restored = row('planner-guard-restores-caller-settings',actor)
    oid = initial['privateAssignmentOid']
    assert type(oid) is str and re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]*',oid)
    assert initial['privateAssignmentPlanVisible'] is True and oid in log(initial)['relationOids']
    equal(initial['planRowEstimates'], log(initial)['planRowEstimates'])
    equal(changed['priorEstimates'], log(initial)['planRowEstimates'])
    equal(changed['changedEstimates'], log(changed)['planRowEstimates'])
    assert changed['priorEstimates'] != changed['changedEstimates']
    assert oid in log(changed)['relationOids']
    record(actor+'/private-world-dependence', True, changed['priorEstimates'] != changed['changedEstimates'])
    record(actor+'/changed-world-authorized-rows', expected_rows[actor], changed['authorizedRows'])
    equal(guarded['privateAssignmentOid'],oid)
    assert guarded['privateAssignmentPlanVisible'] is False
    equal(guarded['planRowEstimates'],['1'])
    record(actor+'/nonvacuous-guarded-transcript', {'oids':[],'estimates':['1']},
        {'oids':log(guarded)['relationOids'],'estimates':log(guarded)['planRowEstimates']})
    record(actor+'/guarded-authorized-rows',expected_rows[actor],guarded['authorizedRows'])
    assert guarded_changed['exactTraceUnchanged'] is True
    record(actor+'/guarded-private-world-transcript-equality',True,
        frozen[str(ROOT/guarded['diagnosticLog'])] == frozen[str(ROOT/guarded_changed['diagnosticLog'])])
    record(actor+'/second-guarded-world-authorized-rows',expected_rows[actor],guarded_changed['authorizedRows'])
    record(actor+'/caller-settings-restored',['on','on','on'],restored['callerSettingsAfterCall'])
    equal(restored['authorizedRows'],expected_rows[actor])
    for parameter in ['debug_print_plan','debug_print_parse','debug_print_rewritten']:
        weakened = row('individual-planner-guard-weakened',actor,parameter)
        equal(weakened['privateAssignmentOid'],oid)
        assert weakened['privateAssignmentPlanVisible'] is True
        record(actor+'/individual-weakening/'+parameter,True,oid in log(weakened)['relationOids'])
        equal(weakened['authorizedRows'],expected_rows[actor])
configuration = ['search_path=pg_catalog','debug_print_plan=off','debug_print_parse=off','debug_print_rewritten=off']
wrapper = {'owner':'umf_sec_guardian','language':'sql','definer':True,'volatility':'s','arguments':0,
    'configuration':configuration,
    'body':" SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_array(id,value) ORDER BY id),'[]'::json) FROM security_raw.resource ",
    'publicExecute':False,'ordinaryExecute':[True,True,True]}
for stage, expected in [('planner-guard-restored-native-configuration',configuration),('planner-guard-independent-wrapper-inventory',wrapper)]:
    observed = row(stage)
    equal(observed['expected'],expected)
    record(stage,expected,observed['observed'])

annex = frozen[str(ROOT/docs[3])].decode()
assert 'text-mode subprocess capture is not a raw-wire byte capture' in annex
assert 'Prepared/cached calls across guard mutation' in annex
assert 'counterexample-found' in annex and '26/132' in annex
source_review = [
    {'id':'capture-before-helper-execution', 'finding':'Reviewed exact self/root guard, selected B01 plan/closure capture, three single-occurrence input-read substitutions, context closure/oracle comparison, captured SQL execution and final digest recheck. Reconstructed prefix was hashed but never executed by this review.'},
    {'id':'native-actor-and-password-boundary', 'finding':'Reviewed helper ordinary TCP SCRAM path using private stdin credentials, original actor/session checks, and excluded installer/assessor connection. No independent native authentication execution.'},
    {'id':'bounded-owned-fixture-side-effects', 'finding':'Two explicit 1000-row population changes and finite 3-actor/3-setting loops execute only in a uniquely named disposable database container. Individual settings reset in finally. This is not a total resource bound.'},
    {'id':'cleanup-source-review', 'finding':'Preexisting fixture refuses; cleanup resolves exact generated name if needed, verifies the unique run label before removal, and final receipt publishes only after successful cleanup. No independent cleanup or cancellation fault injection.'},
    {'id':'guard-scope-and-caller-restoration', 'finding':'Whole fixed definer routine carries all three local debug flags off. Nonempty outer plan remains visible; each flag independently weakened restores the private OID. Same-session caller flags remain on. No prepared/cached guard-mutation claim.'},
    {'id':'documentation-and-requirement-scope', 'finding':'Final annex distinguishes UTF-8 retained decoded stderr from raw-wire custody, the separate routine experiment from original direct-RLS B10, and the tested diagnostic channels from complete observation closure. Configuration drift and complete reachable closure remain unimplemented obligations.'},
]
for path, raw in frozen.items():
    assert Path(path).read_bytes() == raw, 'Input changed: '+path
assert (OUT.read_bytes() if OUT.exists() else None) == prior
receipt = {
    'id':'pg-private-planner-astra-review', 'status':'qualified-retained-planner-review-passed',
    'reviewer':'/root/astra_security_review', 'generatedAt':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'sourceDigests':{p:sha(b) for p,b in frozen.items()}, 'sourcesUnchanged':True,
    'reviewCommand':{'argv':[sys.executable,str(SELF)],'cwd':str(ROOT),
        'sourceSha256':sha(frozen[str(SELF)]),'source':frozen[str(SELF)].decode()},
    'nativeReceipt':{'path':str(NATIVE),'sha256':sha(frozen[str(NATIVE)]),
        'status':native['status'],'engine':native['engine'],'runId':native['runId'],
        'observationCount':94,'reviewedPlannerObservationCount':26,
        'executionAttribution':'Parent native execution; independent review reads retained receipt and logs only.',
        'independentlyExecuted':False},
    'sourceCustody':{'exactNativeSourceDigests':native['sourceDigests'],'frozenHelperInputs':closure,
        'executedHelperPrefixSha256':sha(prefix.encode()),'exactInputReadReplacementCount':3,
        'fixtureSqlExecutedFromCapturedBytes':True,'helperExecutedByReview':False},
    'transcriptAudit':{'count':21,'encoding':'UTF-8 serialization of text-mode decoded stderr; not native raw-wire custody',
        'allDigestsMatched':True,'observations':log_records},
    'observations':observations,'sourceReview':source_review,
    'scope':'Read-only source and retained-evidence audit of the PostgreSQL17.9 planner/parse/rewrite diagnostic counterexample and bounded routine-local mitigation. Independently checked exact five-source closure, reconstructed executed helper-prefix digest, all21 transcript hashes/content,26 planner-stage records, independent authorized row oracle and wrapper metadata expectations. Total94 receipt count is checked but prior68 native paths are not independently reexecuted or comprehensively reviewed here. No PostgreSQL, Cargo, producer, Docker acquisition or helper code executed. Sources and transcript bytes pinned before audit and checked unchanged. Parent text-mode evidence cannot establish raw-wire byte custody. Selected Python executable is pinned; standard library/platform remain trusted. No complete native observation closure, source authentication, runtime hermeticity, production configuration-drift guard or backend admission is proved.',
    'remainingOpenObligations':['prepared/cached calls across guard mutation','complete reachable diagnostic/routine/operator/view and extension closure','installation/configuration drift binding and enforcement','timing/resource/error/cancellation/asynchronous observation coverage'],
    'remainingFindings':[], 'nativeImplementationQualified':False,'independentNativeExecution':False,
    'acceptanceCriteria':['US-056-AC8'],'backendCase':'pg-raw.B10','caseStatus':'counterexample-found',
    'acceptanceCasesPromoted':[],
}
if prior is not None:
    archive = OUT.with_name(OUT.stem+'-prior-'+sha(prior)[:16]+'.json')
    if archive.exists():
        assert archive.read_bytes() == prior
    else:
        archive.write_bytes(prior)
    receipt['preservedPredecessor']={'path':str(archive),'sha256':sha(prior)}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':receipt['status'],'path':str(OUT),'sha256':sha(OUT.read_bytes()),
    'sourcePins':len(frozen),'nativeReceiptObservations':94,'plannerObservationsReviewed':26,
    'transcripts':21,'independentChecks':len(observations),'remainingFindings':[]}))

sourceReview.finding: Reviewed exact self/root guard, selected B01 plan/closure capture, three single-occurrence input-read substitutions, context closure/oracle comparison, captured SQL execution and final digest recheck. Reconstructed prefix was hashed but never executed by this review.
Reviewed helper ordinary TCP SCRAM path using private stdin credentials, original actor/session checks, and excluded installer/assessor connection. No independent native authentication execution.

Two explicit 1000-row population changes and finite 3-actor/3-setting loops execute only in a uniquely named disposable database container. Individual settings reset in finally. This is not a total resource bound.

Preexisting fixture refuses; cleanup resolves exact generated name if needed, verifies the unique run label before removal, and final receipt publishes only after successful cleanup. No independent cleanup or cancellation fault injection.

Whole fixed definer routine carries all three local debug flags off. Nonempty outer plan remains visible; each flag independently weakened restores the private OID. Same-session caller flags remain on. No prepared/cached guard-mutation claim.

Final annex distinguishes UTF-8 retained decoded stderr from raw-wire custody, the separate routine experiment from original direct-RLS B10, and the tested diagnostic channels from complete observation closure. Configuration drift and complete reachable closure remain unimplemented obligations.

scope: Read-only source and retained-evidence audit of the PostgreSQL17.9 planner/parse/rewrite diagnostic counterexample and bounded routine-local mitigation. Independently checked exact five-source closure, reconstructed executed helper-prefix digest, all21 transcript hashes/content,26 planner-stage records, independent authorized row oracle and wrapper metadata expectations. Total94 receipt count is checked but prior68 native paths are not independently reexecuted or comprehensively reviewed here. No PostgreSQL, Cargo, producer, Docker acquisition or helper code executed. Sources and transcript bytes pinned before audit and checked unchanged. Parent text-mode evidence cannot establish raw-wire byte custody. Selected Python executable is pinned; standard library/platform remain trusted. No complete native observation closure, source authentication, runtime hermeticity, production configuration-drift guard or backend admission is proved.
remainingOpenObligations: complete reachable diagnostic/routine/operator/view and extension closure
